title: meta
description:
`meta`: what templates and Lua know about the dashboard, the panel and the run. Runs
Lua, so it asks for trust first. See `:help dbdash-meta`.

show.title: every meta field (refresh with r to fill prev)
show.description: Every meta field and the run records, listed by `lua://`. Press `r` to fill `prev`.

query.sql:
SELECT {{ meta.config_name | sql_quote }} AS config,
       {{ meta.panel_index }} AS panel,
       {{ meta.panel_title | sql_quote }} AS title,
       {{ meta.chart_type | sql_quote }} AS chart,
       {{ meta.max_rows }} AS max_rows,
       {{ meta.timeout }} AS timeout_ms,
       {{ meta.refresh_count }} AS refreshes,
       {{ meta.today | sql_quote }} AS today

show.title: meta in a SQL template
show.description:
A few meta fields in a SQL template; `query.max_rows` and `query.timeout` show up as
`meta.max_rows` and `meta.timeout`.
